name: Bounded Action and Observation Loop
mechanism: Interleaves model decisions with typed tool observations until a deterministic stop condition or hard execution budget is reached.
use_when: The task requires a short adaptive sequence of tool calls
The next useful action depends on the latest tool observation
avoid_when: A deterministic workflow fully specifies the steps
External actions are unsafe without a separate policy gateway
expected_effects: Bounded token tool and latency exposure
failure_modes: Budget exhaustion after repeated equivalent calls
